I'm aware that running a full repo check might interfere with the test suite's performance since it invokes prettier, stylelint, tsc, and oxlint, so I need to be careful about when I run this.

The test suite is running with 8 parallel workers on a 246-file codebase. Running heavy checks concurrently could cause timeout flakes, which would be bad for the validation. I think I should wait for the test suite to finish first, then run hk check and other heavier validations in sequence to avoid interference.
